fit_pca_projector: fit a PCAProjector on a PyTorch tensor of feature vectors with optional max_samples sampling
transform_pca_projector: transform feature vectors using a fitted PCAProjector and return projected tensors on the same device
project_features: apply a list of fitted projectors sequentially to project feature vectors into lower dimensions
serialize_projector_to_tensordict: serialize a PCAProjector into a dictionary of tensors containing components, variance, and singular values
deserialize_projector_from_tensordict: reconstruct a PCAProjector from a serialized tensordict dictionary containing PCA components and parameters
